mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q01.stem: A natural oxide film on aluminium permits omitting all pretreatment.
reasons: True is incorrect. Even with a natural film, pretreatment is needed according to requirements.
False is correct. Even with a natural film, pretreatment is needed according to requirements.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q02.stem: Normal temperature indication permits starting with unconfirmed pretreatment.
reasons: True is incorrect. Material and pretreatment are separate start conditions from temperature.
False is correct. Material and pretreatment are separate start conditions from temperature.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q03.stem: The three fixed controls check item and quantity as well as location.
reasons: True is correct. They are fixed location, fixed item and fixed quantity.
False is inappropriate. They are fixed location, fixed item and fixed quantity.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q04.stem: The ionization-tendency table alone determines every environmental corrosion rate.
reasons: True is incorrect. Surface and environment matter, so rankings alone do not determine rates.
False is correct. Surface and environment matter, so rankings alone do not determine rates.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q05.stem: Check evacuation destinations against anticipated disasters and workplace plans.
reasons: True is correct. Tsunamis, fires and other disasters may require different destinations.
False is inappropriate. Tsunamis, fires and other disasters may require different destinations.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q06.stem: Decorative and hard chromium can have different specifications and tests.
reasons: True is correct. Different purposes can mean different thickness, conditions and inspection.
False is inappropriate. Different purposes can mean different thickness, conditions and inspection.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q07.stem: Normality N is invariant for the same substance in every reaction.
reasons: True is incorrect. Even one substance's equivalent value can change with the reaction definition.
False is correct. Even one substance's equivalent value can change with the reaction definition.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q08.stem: Delete unfavorable thickness values before averaging.
reasons: True is incorrect. Deleting abnormal values hides measurement reality.
False is correct. Deleting abnormal values hides measurement reality.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q09.stem: After stopping, obtain designated checks before restarting even if the abnormality appears gone.
reasons: True is correct. Cause checks and restart permission remain needed after stopping.
False is inappropriate. Cause checks and restart permission remain needed after stopping.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q10.stem: A histogram alone obscures the measurement time sequence.
reasons: True is correct. Grouping values into intervals hides their original order.
False is inappropriate. Grouping values into intervals hides their original order.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q11.stem: Voltage 12 A can be corrected simply by changing A to V without checking facts.
reasons: True is incorrect. Do not change only the unit before confirming what was measured.
False is correct. Do not change only the unit before confirming what was measured.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q12.stem: In ordinary circuit diagrams, a voltmeter connects in parallel across the target points.
reasons: True is correct. Voltage is the potential difference between two points, measured in parallel.
False is inappropriate. Voltage is the potential difference between two points, measured in parallel.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q13.stem: A small event count means major safety issues must always be deferred.
reasons: True is incorrect. Do not lower a major safety issue's priority solely from a small count.
False is correct. Do not lower a major safety issue's priority solely from a small count.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q14.stem: Record sample temperature even when comparing the same specific gravity.
reasons: True is correct. Liquid temperature affects density and instrument-reading conditions.
False is inappropriate. Liquid temperature affects density and instrument-reading conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q15.stem: A readable document permits using another process's standard.
reasons: True is incorrect. Readability does not guarantee matching applicability.
False is correct. Readability does not guarantee matching applicability.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q16.stem: Natural oxide and a controlled anodic film need not be identical.
reasons: True is correct. Their structures and thicknesses can differ.
False is inappropriate. Their structures and thicknesses can differ.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q17.stem: A robot that appears stopped can be entered after disabling the interlock.
reasons: True is incorrect. Do not disable an interlock to enter.
False is correct. Do not disable an interlock to enter.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q18.stem: Discoloration the day after storage is always caused only by storage.
reasons: True is incorrect. Compare storage, rinsing and drying candidates before deciding.
False is correct. Compare storage, rinsing and drying candidates before deciding.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q19.stem: Parallel branches have the same voltage across their ends.
reasons: True is correct. They share the same two connection points and therefore voltage.
False is inappropriate. They share the same two connection points and therefore voltage.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q20.stem: pH alone determines every metal concentration in a bath.
reasons: True is incorrect. pH does not quantify every metal constituent.
False is correct. pH does not quantify every metal constituent.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q21.stem: Check both sides and holes when finding total treatment area.
reasons: True is correct. Area calculations follow conditions for both sides and interiors too.
False is inappropriate. Area calculations follow conditions for both sides and interiors too.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q22.stem: Check jig contact condition separately even when the supply display is correct.
reasons: True is correct. Bad contact can prevent the intended current from reaching the item.
False is inappropriate. Bad contact can prevent the intended current from reaching the item.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q23.stem: A burette is normally filled by mouth suction.
reasons: True is incorrect. Mouth suction creates ingestion or exposure hazards and must not be used.
False is correct. Mouth suction creates ingestion or exposure hazards and must not be used.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q24.stem: Match total incoming and outgoing currents at a junction.
reasons: True is correct. Match incoming and outgoing current as a charge balance.
False is inappropriate. Match incoming and outgoing current as a charge balance.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q25.stem: One identically named course is sufficient for every hazardous task.
reasons: True is incorrect. Qualification and course applicability varies with work and conditions.
False is correct. Qualification and course applicability varies with work and conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q26.stem: Check quality and safety impacts even for circular-use improvements.
reasons: True is correct. Confirm resource saving does not increase defects or hazards.
False is inappropriate. Confirm resource saving does not increase defects or hazards.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q27.stem: Near delivery deadlines, normally ignore abnormal vibration and continue.
reasons: True is incorrect. Continuing abnormalities can increase accidents or quality defects.
False is correct. Continuing abnormalities can increase accidents or quality defects.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q28.stem: Separate observed facts from suspected causes in reports.
reasons: True is correct. Distinguishing speculation reduces misunderstanding and decision errors.
False is inappropriate. Distinguishing speculation reduces misunderstanding and decision errors.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q29.stem: Zinc never corrodes even in acidic or alkaline environments.
reasons: True is incorrect. Zinc also corrodes under acid, alkali and other conditions.
False is correct. Zinc also corrodes under acid, alkali and other conditions.

mfg1-surface-mock-08-theory-q30.stem: Fan-noise measures must preserve necessary exhaust performance.
reasons: True is correct. Stopping exhaust must not increase harmful exposure elsewhere.
False is inappropriate. Stopping exhaust must not increase harmful exposure elsewhere.
